title: ISO 6358-1:2013 — Pneumatic fluid power — Determination of flow-rate characteristics of components using compressible fluids — Part 1: General rules and test methods for steady-state flow
locator: Official abstract and lifecycle: steady-state flow characteristic test for applicable gas-flow components; excludes unstable/hysteretic or feedback components such as regulators, and energy-exchanging components such as cylinders and accumulators; Amd 1 covers effective conductance and Amd 2 measurement uncertainty.
notes: Do not apply the steady-state flow-characteristic method to regulators or cylinders excluded from its scope. Preserve the amendment set, test configuration, measurement uncertainty and flow-result conditions.
